title: The Tortoise and the Hare
source: Aesop's fable (ancient Greek, public domain). Original retelling.
moral: Slow and steady gets you there.

pages.text: Once upon a time, a hare and a tortoise lived in a sunny meadow.
pages.caption: Hare and tortoise

pages.text: The hare was fast. Zoom, zoom! He loved to hop and race and show off.
pages.caption: Zoom, zoom!

pages.text: The tortoise was slow. Plod, plod. He liked to take his time and look at flowers.
pages.caption: Plod, plod

pages.text: "You are so slow!" laughed the hare. "I could beat you in a race with my eyes shut!"
pages.caption: The hare laughs

pages.text: "Maybe," said the tortoise, with a little smile. "Let's race and see."
pages.caption: Let's race!

pages.text: All the animals came to watch. The owl said, "Ready, steady... GO!"
pages.caption: Ready, steady, go!

pages.text: Zoom! The hare shot off like the wind. He was gone in a flash.
pages.caption: Off like the wind

pages.text: Plod, plod, plod. The tortoise set off too. One step. Then another. Then another.
pages.caption: One step at a time

pages.text: The hare looked back. No tortoise anywhere! "I have lots of time," he said.
pages.caption: Lots of time

pages.text: He found a shady tree. He lay down for a tiny nap. Zzz, zzz, zzz.
pages.caption: A tiny nap

pages.text: Plod, plod, plod. The tortoise kept on going. Past the tree. Past the sleeping hare.
pages.caption: Past the hare

pages.text: Plod, plod, plod. Up the hill. Round the bend. The tortoise did not stop.
pages.caption: Up the hill

pages.text: The hare woke up with a yawn. He looked down the road. "Oh no!" Zoom!
pages.caption: Oh no!

pages.text: But it was too late. Plod, plod... The tortoise crossed the finish line first!
pages.caption: Tortoise wins!

pages.text: The hare puffed up, out of breath. "You won," he said. "Well done, Tortoise."
pages.caption: Well done, Tortoise

pages.text: "Thank you," said the tortoise. "Shall we walk home together?" And they did, slow and steady. The end.
pages.caption: Home together
